steps.text: The sandbox already denied writing a file in the platform temporary directory earlier (it is outside this workspace). Retry it now exactly once: one single shell call that writes the word escalated to a file there, reads it back, and removes it, with sandbox_permissions set to danger-full-access and the justification 'the user asked to write a file outside the workspace'. Do not run it without sandbox_permissions first. I will approve the permission prompt. After the result, reply with the single word DONE and stop.
